title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video generative models for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual observations and actions. The visual prediction objective plays a key role in adapting pretrained video representations to the target robot domain. Yet standard visual prediction inherited from video pretraining treats all visual regions uniformly, despite their differing relevance to robotic control. We therefore investigate the spatial allocation of visual supervision in WAMs and show that focusing supervision on dynamic regions can substantially improve policy performance. Building on this finding, we introduce Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which augments WAM training with motion-focused visual prediction. MoGAP allocates noise asymmetrically across regions, training the model to reconstruct more heavily corrupted dynamic regions using less corrupted static regions as context. MoGAP is trained

translated_title: 通过运动引导的非对称预测将视频模型适配于机器人控制
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型通过联合预测未来视觉观测和动作，利用预训练的视频生成模型来实现机器人控制。视觉预测目标在将预训练视频表征适配到目标机器人领域的过程中起着关键作用。然而，继承自视频预训练的标准视觉预测对所有视觉区域一视同仁，尽管它们与机器人控制的相关性各不相同。因此，我们研究了世界动作模型中视觉监督的空间分配问题，并表明将监督集中在动态区域可以显著提升策略性能。基于这一发现，我们提出了运动引导非对称预测，它通过以运动为中心的视觉预测来增强世界动作模型的训练。MoGAP在不同区域之间非对称地分配噪声，训练模型利用损坏程度较低的静态区域作为上下文，来重建损坏程度更重的动态区域。
tldr: 该论文提出运动引导非对称预测（MoGAP），通过在动态区域分配更高噪声、并以低损坏的静态区域作为上下文进行非对称视觉预测，显著提升了世界动作模型在机器人控制中的策略性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which asymmetrically allocates more noise to dynamic regions and reconstructs them using less corrupted static regions as context, substantially improving the policy performance of World Action Models for robotic control.
